description: Puts a saved site live at its own free address, name.iter0.app, so anyone can open it. Free: it uses no credits. Takes the designId and, optionally, a name for the address (lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, 3 to 63 characters; without one, iter0 uses the free address it suggests). Called without confirmationToken, nothing goes live: it returns the exact address and a confirmationToken. Called again with the same designId and that confirmationToken, it publishes, and the site becomes public. A confirmationToken cannot publish twice. If the site is already live and up to date it says so and needs no token. If the result says the outcome is unknown, iter0_publish_status shows whether the site is live. Only the site's owner can publish.

confirmationToken.description: Leave out on the first call. On the second call pass the token the first call returned, unchanged.

designId.description: The saved design, from iter0_get_design or iter0_list_my_designs.

subdomain.description: The name for the address: name.iter0.app. Optional; only on the first call, and only when the person chose a name.

name: iter0_publish_site

lastConfirmedAt.description: When iter0 last saw the live release serve at its address (ISO time). A past observation, not a check made now.

title: Publish a site
